EpicycleStep: Instantaneous state of a single epicycle in the rotating chain at phase t in [0, 1].

FourierTransform: High-performance Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) engine for 2D parametric curves. Given sampled complex points z_k = x_k + i*y_k along a curve, calculates complex Fourier coefficients c_n such that: Z(t) = c_0 + sum_{n != 0} c_n * exp(i * 2 * PI * n * t) Recreates the exact mathematical visualization style pioneered by Grant Sanderson (3Blue1Brown) and Manim, where epicycles can be sorted by magnitude so the largest dominant circles rotate first, followed by increasingly fine detailed sub-epicycles.
